data.gender_notes: Alyaaz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'alaa' meaning 'to rise above, to be exalted, to be noble'. In Islamic tradition, it is a name given to those who are considered to be of high status, esteemed, and respected. The name Alyaaz carries the meaning “Exalted, noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Alyaaz usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alyaaz total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
